description: This file declares the UnsecuredWebSocketClient class, which implements the IWebSocketClient interface, facilitating WebSocket connections without encryption. It includes constructor, destructor, connect, disconnect, and getConnectionType methods, as well as a private member WebSocketClientImpl with NoEncryption.

classes.name: UnsecuredWebSocketClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client implementation that operates without encryption, providing functionalities to connect, disconnect, and identify connection type, associated with an AudioPlayer.

methods.name: UnsecuredWebSocketClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket client with a given AudioPlayer instance.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the WebSocket connection to a specified URI.

methods.name: getConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the type of WebSocket connection, indicating it's unsecured.
